description: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division (access review; no current free bulk file) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/hi-breg-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division (BREG)
sources.license: None stated. The only open file is a City and County of Honolulu Socrata copy (dataset 9k54-ztb8, 'Hawaii Business Registration'), last updated 2022-06-08, with the note 'This dataset is out of date. Current business registration can be viewed at the Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs at https://hbe.dcca.hawaii.gov/'
sources.gate: Purchase or records request: BREG says it offers 'bulk downloads of information through its online services' and special subscriptions, but no product name, price or file format was found (breg@dcca.hawaii.gov, 808-586-2727). A person must ask BREG for the bulk product and its terms. The Honolulu copy is four years old, is not the publisher's file, and is not used.
sources.notes: The stale copy has 32 text columns (File No., Name, Master Name, Business Type, Status, Place Incorporated, Registration Date, Mailing Address, Agent Name, ...). Not archived. robots.txt: data.honolulu.gov Crawl-delay none, Socrata defaults. BREG's contact page says a new online portal launches 2026-07-06; the search tool in use is Hawaii Business Express (hbe.dcca.hawaii.gov), an interactive search that is not automated.
